source_contract.carrier_proxy: Vessel::liquid_volume sums liquid-phase species volume; hydraulic_liquid_volume subtracts stationary surface-reference water release only. Inlet and all cells must match.
source_contract.tr003: Aqueous carbonate basis shifts carrier water: cell 0.019999968580779747 L versus inlet 0.020 L differs by 1.57096 ppm, just beyond the 1 ppm gate. Equal original 20 mL dispenses do not establish equal post-solve geometry.
source_contract.tr007: Gypsum releases two water molecules per dissolved formula unit. Dissolved Ca 0.00031207016247782477 mol gives 0.00062414032495565 mol additional water, matching the required 0.020011277721117417 L. Other cells/inlet remain 0.020 L. This changes the proxy by about 564 ppm and is not decimal roundoff.

conservation_scope: No transport step completed in either witness; last snapshots precede first refused transport. Source validates geometry before update. These outputs do not demonstrate lost matter or an invalid transport result.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not relax tolerance to fit these scripts.
Do not remove mineral chemistry, relabel ions, delete hydration water or normalize chemistry away.
Do not tune inlet dose from first output and call it general reactive-transport support.
acceptance_lanes: Decide whether fixed hydraulic geometry should be separate from conserved mobile-water volume; publish supported assumptions and explicit refusals.
If extending, derive finite mineral/hydrate/interface water ownership and associated hydraulic displacement/overflow and energy ledger. Preserve total element/charge/water accounting.
Positive conservative transport and existing surface-reference controls must remain accepted; invalid genuinely unequal geometries must still refuse.
Freeze carbonate and hydrate controls through repeated transport/re-equilibration, inlet sampling and receiver accumulation; no blind reruns before reviewed design.
